full_judgment: 28. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, we are constrained to hold the view that the prosecution has measurably failed to prove the charge leveled against the accused, even than the trial court convicted the appellant most arbitrarily on mere presumption, accordingly the impugned judgment and order of conviction is liable to be set-aside. We thus find merits in this appeal.
